description: This Java class 'ModifySubjectsStrategy' handles the 'ModifySubjects' command related to policy subject modifications within a policy management system. It extends 'AbstractPolicyCommandStrategy' and implements logic to validate, update, and generate events or errors based on the command and current policy state.

classes.name: ModifySubjectsStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the 'ModifySubjects' command, validating and applying subject modifications to policies.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic: validates the target policy, updates subjects for a specific label if valid, and produces either a success result with a SubjectsModified event or an error result.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityTag representing the previous state of the policy's subjects for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates an EntityTag representing the new state of the policy's subjects after modification.
